English: Wicker Idol Stand
A humble altar of woven twigs and straw, marking the first sacred site for nomadic prayers and offerings to the spirits.
Ancestor Tree
A sacred tree planted to honor the clans ancestors, where offerings and tokens are left to seek their guidance and favor.
Stone Circle
An arrangement of standing stones used for rituals under the open sky, signifying a growing religious gathering place.
Spirit Clearing
A well-kept sacred space in the wild, where shamans commune with spirits. Used for significant rituals and clan gatherings.
Priests Hut
A permanent wooden structure for the chief shaman or priest, symbolizing organized spiritual leadership and continuity.
Sanctuary Pavilion
A great tented structure for seasonal festivals, sheltering sacred relics and hosting large clan ceremonies.
Blessed Glade
A grove imbued with ancient magic, cared for by the priesthood and revered by all clans for its perceived protection and luck.
Diviners Chamber
A secluded, richly adorned lodge for the most trusted seers, where visions and omens guide the fate of the horde.
Holy Sanctuary
A complex of wooden shrines, sacred fires, and ritual grounds, serving as the spiritual heart of the steppe clans.
Pagan Sacred Grove
An expansive, ancient grove protected by stone monuments and attended by a council of priests, drawing pilgrims from across the steppes.
